title: Compact PX world state
root_cause: Operators must hydrate many large registries to learn current source, blockers, staleness, capability, agent, model, hardware, authority, and evidence state.
source_requirement: Generate a small metadata-only world-state projection with lazy detail links.
implementation_steps: Define bounded projection schema and size budget.
Collect only compact current summaries and exact revisions.
List blockers/stale projections and next actions.
affected_tests: Startup metadata, generated artifacts, dashboard API tests.
evidence_required: Deterministic projection, size budget, metadata-only startup proof.
rollback: Remove generated world-state consumer and retain source registries.
acceptance_criteria: Projection stays within declared size/count budgets.
Startup reads summaries without hydrating detail bodies.
